name: Synopsys

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org - Wikipedia infobox logo file: Synopsys Logo.svg

description: Synopsys sells the chip-design software (EDA), ready-made chip design blocks (IP) and, since it closed the $34.9B Ansys merger in July 2025, engineering simulation software used to test products from chips to cars and aircraft. Design Automation (EDA plus Ansys) is three quarters of revenue and is mostly time-based licences that recur; Design IP is licensed per block, largely up front, and depends on a few large chip customers and foundries. FY2025 was hit in IP by China export controls and weaker demand from a major foundry customer, and the company launched a restructuring in November 2025. NVIDIA bought about $2.0B of Synopsys stock in December 2025.

gics.note: Conventional label as listed in the Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' table (GICS sector and GICS sub-industry columns). That table does not give the industry group or industry levels, so they are null rather than filled from memory.

employees.note: About 28,000, about 23% in the US; headcount grew about 40% in fiscal 2025 mainly from the Ansys merger (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Design Automation
businessLines.how: Customers pay for multi-year time-based software licences (recognised over the term) plus hardware and maintenance; Ansys adds recurring simulation licences to manufacturers.
businessLines.description: Silicon design and verification software and hardware, manufacturing software, and Ansys simulation and analysis products.

businessLines.name: Design IP
businessLines.how: Per-design licence fees for each IP block (mostly recognised up front when delivered) plus royalties and implementation services; lumpy and tied to a few large customers.
businessLines.description: Interface, foundation, security and embedded-processor IP, IP subsystems and IP implementation services.
